name: ZaoSeq Bopomofo v0.2 sealed evaluation decision plan
written_before: TEST-V1 was built or read, and before any TEST-V1 result existed

systems.S1_v01_decoder: V0 decoder (frozen V0: government LM, builtin lexicon, beam 48, nbest 20) — the v0.1 candidate system
systems.S2_v02_decoder: v0.2 semantic-frozen decoder (S5_tatoeba_common_voice), cache-disabled reference path
systems.S3_v01_final: frozen fine-tuned Laya (production ranker, K=4) on S1 candidates — the v0.1 final system (FINAL.json 'fine-tuned Laya')
systems.S4_v02_final: the same frozen Laya (K=4) on S2 candidates — the v0.2 final system

scoring: a system output is correct iff the CandidateFamily key of its top candidate equals the key of any acceptable text (same as DEV and v0.1 TEST)
run: TEST-V1 is evaluated exactly once. All four systems run in that single evaluation. No setting, file or rule may be changed after any TEST-V1 result is seen.
primary_endpoint: TEST-V1-EVERYDAY final top-1: S4 vs S3, paired by item

pass_criteria.P2_everyday_significance: exact two-sided McNemar (binomial) p < 0.05 on the paired S3/S4 correctness of TEST-V1-EVERYDAY
pass_criteria.P4_gov_bound: top1(S4) - top1(S3) on TEST-V1-GOV >= -0.020 (the same bound as the v0.2 selection-plan GOV teacher gate)

validity_invariants.I1_semantic_freeze: semantic_freeze verify (including raw sources) passes immediately before the run and again after it
validity_invariants.I2_sealed_files: benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_SEALED.json verifies (TEST files, manifest, plans, gate, evaluation code unchanged)
validity_invariants.I3_gate: benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_TEST_GATE.json exists, predates the TEST files, and its hashes still match
validity_invariants.I4_single_run: the results file does not exist before the run; the runner refuses to run a second time
validity_invariants.I5_determinism: S2 re-decodes the first 50 TEST-V1-EVERYDAY items a second time with identical candidate texts and scores
validity_invariants.I6_reference_path: S2 uses the language model without any cache wrapper
validity_invariants.I7_approved_sources: every production daily source used by S2 is APPROVED with production scope
validity_invariants.I8_leakage: benchmarks/test_v1/DEDUP_REPORT.json shows 0 flagged items in the final sets

decision.PROCEDURAL_INVALID: any validity invariant fails, or the run cannot be completed as planned; the TEST is then treated as REFERENCE and not reused as sealed
decision.PASS: all validity invariants hold and P1, P2, P3 and P4 all hold
decision.FAIL: all validity invariants hold and at least one of P1-P4 fails; TEST-V1 becomes REFERENCE, a failure taxonomy is reported, and no change is made against this TEST

reported_not_gating: decoder top-1, MRR, R@3, R@5, R@10, character accuracy, teacher-window coverage (top-4 families) for S1 and S2 on both sets
final top-1 and character accuracy for S3 and S4 on both sets
S1 vs S2 decoder paired wrong->correct / correct->wrong and exact McNemar p on both sets
S3 vs S4 paired counts and exact McNemar p on TEST-V1-GOV
per-category final top-1 on TEST-V1-EVERYDAY and per-domain on TEST-V1-GOV
no latency claim: timings from this run are not release latency
not_a_criterion: the DEV result (Coverage-DEV teacher 0.800, +0.103 over V0) is not expected to be reproduced; the TEST only has to show that the improvement generalizes
